svg.title: Durable commits on macOS: each engine's cost relative to Ledger (a bar to the right is slower or larger than Ledger, to the left faster or smaller)
svg.text: One durable 1.5 KB write, latency Ledger: 628 +- 5.4 us/op

Durable writes per second, 1 committer Ledger: 1,618 +- 10,416 ops/s

circle.title: lmdb: 1,622 +- 3,892 ops/s, the same as Ledger

svg.text: Durable writes per second, 8 concurrent committers Ledger: 9,792 +- 9,579 ops/s

Webhook deliveries stored durably and removed once handled, 4 at a time Ledger: 4,721 +- 14,399 ops/s
